svg.title: Guide 02 - crosscut plan for the 2x2 and 2x4 sticks
svg.text: 2x2 SPF, eight 8' boards (square one end first, measure every length from it)
board #8 (on hand): kick sleepers, cut to suit in guide 6
untouched, 78 - keep for shims, bearers and cauls
Crosscut plan, bars to a common length scale. Hatched tails are the leftovers with the kerfs taken out - keep them, they are sleeper length.
